name: wst-builder
responsibility: Package reusable WESEO Smart Template Builder workflows for creating WordPress, ACF, CPT, and WST foundations before local frontend implementation.
assumptions: The plugin is used in a Cursor workspace that has access to a WordPress and WST project checkout.

Project-specific CPT names, URL slugs, Flexible Content field keys, field post IDs, clone group keys, WPGB IDs, WordPress paths, WP-CLI commands, cache commands, theme quirks, URLs, and branch details live in the project-local template.
Server-side WST setup starts from a project-configured handoff draft before final CSS, responsive QA, and Playwright checks begin in the local frontend phase.

rules.name: acf-wst-patterns
rules.description: Preserve reusable ACF Flexible Content, clone field, shortcode, and WST template invariants for WST Builder work.

skills.name: wst-new-fc-section

skills.name: wst-new-post-type
skills.description: Create a WST Custom Post Type foundation, including required preflight, dedicated CPT handoff draft, optional taxonomy, ACF CPT fields, WP Grid Builder grid/card foundation, card template, and optional single template.
